item.title: Design 6729
item.description: Design 6729 – mustard yellow saree, poori body par figure aur phool-patti wala position print, saath mein red, green aur blue ka multicolour border aur bhara hua pallu. 🌼 Matching yellow blouse ke saath traditional, festive look – pooja, haldi, tyohaar aur family function ke customers ke liye achha option. Saree shops, boutiques aur resellers ke liye seedha Surat ke manufacturer se wholesale mein. Design 6729 - App mein search kijiye 📱 Poora ready-stock catalogue B.B Synthetics App mein hai, order bhi wahin se hota hai.
